Q1001. SSC CGL Reasoning – Identify the next number in the series: 3, 5, 7, 9, ?
    A. 11
    B. 13
    C. 22
    D. 10

Answer: 11
Solution: This is an arithmetic sequence with a common difference of 2. Starting from 3, each term increases by 2, so after 9 the next term is 11.

Q2501. IBPS PO Quantitative Aptitude – Calculate the simple interest on Rs. 1000 at 4% per annum for 1 years.
    A. 40.0
    B. 190.0
    C. 0
    D. 80.0

Answer: 40.0
Solution: Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100 = (1000 × 4 × 1)/100 = 40.0.

    B. 7546.8
    C. 7316.8
    D. 14793.6

Answer: 7396.8
Solution: Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100 = (30820 × 8 × 3)/100 = 7396.8.

Q3496. IBPS PO Quantitative Aptitude – Calculate the simple interest on Rs. 30850 at 4% per annum for 4 years.
    A. 4936.0
    B. 5086.0
    C. 4856.0
    D. 9872.0

Answer: 4936.0
Solution: Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100 = (30850 × 4 × 4)/100 = 4936.0.

Q3497. IBPS PO Quantitative Aptitude – Calculate the simple interest on Rs. 30880 at 5% per annum for 1 years.
    A. 1544.0
    B. 1694.0
    C. 1464.0
    D. 3088.0

Answer: 1544.0
Solution: Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100 = (30880 × 5 × 1)/100 = 1544.0.
